- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Brahmin Pen__

**Produces**

Fertilizer

1 per camp

3 per workshop

None

Resources

5 Fertilizer

In-Game Plan - __Plan: Brahmin Pen__

1 minute and 48 seconds

Yes

None

11 Flamingo Units
